description: Synthetic priority boundary probes, not a validated ranking benchmark. Keep separate from real-case evaluation.

state.evidence: Three workflows produced 33 unchanged pending results and 157 model rounds that only asked for pending status.
state.next_step: Use the existing blocking wait when progress is unchanged; keep checks that enable other work.
state.verify: Compare pending-only rounds and p95 completion latency on matched delegations.
state.limit: Confirm on comparable tasks before rollout.

state.evidence: 2,367 slow tool calls; the longest call-to-result interval was 16 hours. The operation and external wait are unclassified.
state.next_step: Cut every tool timeout to 30 seconds.
state.limit: Duration is not CPU time; the call may be doing required work or waiting externally.

state.evidence: Seventeen expensive runs cost $1,821 in total, but accepted scope and outcome are unknown.
state.limit: Some runs may be large requested work; completion quality is unmeasured.

state.evidence: Forty-five groups crossed a cache-write threshold with $130.91 in estimated write charges.
state.next_step: Inspect prompt-prefix fingerprints and expiry before changing cache policy.
state.verify: Compare write tokens and input charge per completed task.
state.limit: Prefix identity and expiry are unobserved; charge is not proven waste.

state.evidence: Seventeen outbound strings matched a credential-shaped pattern in eleven runs.
state.limit: Pattern matches do not prove values are valid or exposed to an unauthorized recipient.

state.evidence: The agent declared completion after editing and ran no build or test after its last edit.
state.next_step: Require a relevant check after the final edit, or state explicitly why verification could not run.
state.verify: Measure final-edit-to-check coverage and accepted task outcomes.
state.limit: Some changes cannot be exercised locally; preserve an explicit unavailable path.

state.evidence: A command returned the same diagnostic four times; the next calls reused identical arguments with no intervening state change.
state.next_step: After a repeated identical failure, require a changed hypothesis or stop-and-report path before another call.
state.verify: Compare repeat calls per resolved blocker and recovery completion.
state.limit: Do not suppress retries after state changes.

state.evidence: Most delegation records have no exact child completion or parent-consumption marker.
state.next_step: Record explicit child completion, cancellation, and parent consumption in the trace.
state.verify: Reduce the share with unknown lifecycle state.
state.limit: Missing joins do not prove a child hung; this is an observability change.

state.evidence: A detector fired 3,786 times, but its underlying operations and outcomes are not classified.
state.next_step: Inspect a stratified sample and identify distinct causes.
state.verify: Measure share of reviewed samples with a common cause.
state.limit: A large count can mix expected and harmful behavior.

state.evidence: The agent edited files without a recorded read; the user may have supplied the exact patch context.
state.next_step: Force a full-file read before every edit.
state.limit: The read could be redundant or costly; the sample lacks outcome checks.
